templates.label: Accessible aircraft lavatory
templates.question: Does the aircraft currently assigned to this flight have an accessible lavatory? Please provide the configuration or feature details you can confirm.

templates.label: Movable aisle armrest
templates.question: Does the booked seat have a movable aisle armrest? Please confirm the specific seat or cabin configuration.

templates.label: Seat width
templates.question: What is the usable width of the booked seat, and in which unit was it measured?

templates.label: Mobility-device acceptance
templates.question: Can you confirm whether the mobility device documented on this booking is accepted for this itinerary, including any applicable size or handling conditions?

templates.label: Mobility-device battery capacity limit
templates.question: What is the maximum allowed battery capacity limit in Watt-hours for mobility devices on this flight, and what handling rules apply?

templates.label: Lithium-ion battery acceptance
templates.question: Can you confirm whether lithium-ion batteries powering mobility devices are accepted for this flight under applicable dangerous goods rules?

templates.label: Manual wheelchair cabin stowage
templates.question: Does this aircraft have a designated in-cabin stowage space for at least one adult-sized collapsible manual wheelchair?

templates.label: Step-free flight boarding
templates.question: Is boarding and deplaning for this flight step-free via jet bridge, ambulift, or ramp access?

templates.label: Roll-in shower
templates.question: Does the booked room have a roll-in shower? Please describe the shower entry and confirm any threshold or lip details you can verify.

templates.label: Shower entry lip height
templates.question: What is the shower-entry lip height for the booked room, measured at the highest point, and in which unit?

templates.label: Room doorway clear width
templates.question: What is the clear width of the doorway to the booked room, measured at its narrowest point, and in which unit?

templates.label: Bed height
templates.question: What is the height from the floor to the top of the mattress in the booked room, and in which unit?

templates.label: Elevator-served room
templates.question: Is the booked room reached by an elevator without stairs on the route? Please describe any steps or route conditions you can confirm.

templates.label: Step-free route
templates.question: Is the route from the property entrance to the booked room step-free? Please identify any thresholds, ramps, or lift conditions you can confirm.

templates.label: Wheelchair-compatible transfer vehicle
templates.question: Can you confirm the assigned transfer vehicle's wheelchair-access features and the vehicle configuration? Please state any measurements or limits you can verify.

templates.label: Transfer ramp or lift
templates.question: Does the assigned transfer vehicle have a ramp or lift? Please provide the type and any operating limits you can confirm.
